source_note: Transcribed from nine photos of the field sheets (PXL_20261030_030836348.jpg to PXL_20261030_030946753.jpg).

days.notes: No spot-check sheet was completed for Kerleske Island. The TB2 ortho flight notes "+ spot checks".

spot: Aircraft disconnected. Moved to points closer to home
Aircraft disconnected and landed. Retrieved from shore

appendix_notes: The four spot-check sheets carry no date or site. They are matched to days by photo order (each spot-check sheet was photographed straight after its orthomosaic sheet): 27 Oct Milikapiti, 28 Oct Pretty Flowers, 29 Oct Family Point, 30 Oct Timasambu.
Ditto marks (") are expanded to the value in the row above.

Where an entry is crossed out, the replacement is recorded: 27 Oct R4 start 9:30 -> 10:20; 27 Oct TB3 start battery 100 -> 70; 29 Oct spot-check R3 and R1 start times; 30 Oct spot-check TB2 pilot AN -> KW (see below).
27 Oct ortho: "Rooster" is struck out and "Tiwi" written in, so the model is recorded as Mavic 3 / Tiwi.

28 Oct Kerleske Island: the sheet is dated 28/10/2020, read as 2026. Two sites were flown on 28 Oct (Mavic 3T Tiwi at Pretty Flowers ortho; Mavic 3 Rooster for Pretty Flowers spot checks and Kerleske ortho).
Kerleske Island has no spot-check sheet, so that section is left out of its page.
Battery IDs and drone names are recorded as written, including mixed R / TB prefixes on the same aircraft.
Spot-check numbers wrap round, so ranges like 50-5 (27 Oct) and 50-09 (30 Oct) are recorded as written: they run from 50 to the end of the list and on from 1.
28 Oct Kerleske R4 start 11:40 has its hour digits retraced; it reads 11:40.
29 Oct ortho altitude is written "37" with no unit.
red_items: 27 Oct spot-check R5: end time 11:14. The minutes digit is overwritten; could be 11:24.
28 Oct Kerleske R5: start 11:14 and end 11:38. Both are overwritten (start could read 11:44, end could read 12:38). 11:14-11:38 fits the next flight starting 11:40.
28 Oct Kerleske altitude: read as 24 m (first digit could be a 7).
29 Oct spot-check R4: stop battery 25 could be 23; the 7 in "40-57" is written over a 5.
29 Oct spot-check R3: end time 11:30 (minutes overwritten), stop battery 70 (overwritten), completed numbers 79-89 (first digit overwritten; could be 71). 79-89 fits the unsuccessful range 56-78.
29 Oct spot-check R1: pilot cell has a crossed-out letter then a ditto mark; recorded as AN + Tiwi Rangers.
30 Oct site name: written "Timasambu"; could be a different spelling of the place name.
30 Oct spot-check pilot: "AN" is scribbled over with "KW" written beneath; recorded as KW (could mean AN + KW). TB1 and TB3 are ditto.
30 Oct spot-check TB2: start time 10:23. The minutes are overwritten; could be 10:30 or 10:33.
